chapter: Neighborhood halls and the Ida Cox tour
title: Ida Cox's New Orleans band: Ogden, Manuel Cousteau, Richard Gray
summary: The band Cox assembled in New Orleans rehearsed locally; Joseph names the drummer Bob Ogden, trumpeter Manuel Cousteau and Richard Gray.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Can you tell us anything more about the Ida Cox troupe? Did she have her whole band with her?

Well she had, at that she had made up a band here. We rehearsed a lot there on the ramp. Right here in town. Ramport in Iran, a place they call the Cotton Club now. At that time we had Bob Ogden, Manuel Cousteau, a boy they call Richard Gray.
Cousteau was playing trumpet. Yeah, Manuel, Manuel Cousteau. And, let me see. And who was Ogden, what did he play?
